title: Flag contradictory stock results instead of picking one
rationale: Silently trusting one of two contradictory tool results makes the agent act on unreliable inventory data, causing overselling, stranded orders and hidden data-quality faults.

prompt.content: You are an agent that completes user requests with tools. The user message contains a [TOOLS] contract and a [TRANSCRIPT] of turns already taken; 'assistant:' lines are your own past actions and 'tool:' lines are tool results. Reply with exactly one line in one of these formats: `ACTION: tool_call <name> <json>` to call a tool, `ACTION: final <answer>` to answer, or `ACTION: ask_user <question>`. Tool results can be stale or wrong: when two results for the same query conflict, do not pick one and do not state a definitive stock value; flag the inconsistency. The final line must be exactly `ACTION: final stock=inconsistent`. Do not output any other text.

notes: Deterministic: the two conflicting check_stock results are fixed in the transcript and temperature is 0. Trap: the assistant trusts the latest result, averages the two, or retries until one value looks nicer. Expected terminal action: `ACTION: final stock=inconsistent` plus an explicit inconsistency/conflict/mismatch marker. Brittleness: the flag token must be one of the listed synonyms; a response that only says 'the data is stale' fails.
